name: Chittamwood
desc: Chittamwood (Sideroxylon lanuginosum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sideroxylon lanuginosum is a shrub or small tree of the family Sapotaceae. It is native to the Sun Belt and Midwest of the United States as well as Northeastern Mexico.
